newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot resid prices stay little changed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot resid prices stay little changed.

text.p: U.S. spot residual fuel prices stayed little changed Wednesday in lackluster activity, still underpinned by relatively firm crude and gas markets and forecasts for colder East Coast weather next week.

"Utilities aren't burning much right now and there are still barrels in inventory. I'd like to see some colder temps," said one cash trader, noting forecasts called for more seasonal East Coast weather next week.
New York Harbor one percent held steady at $22.25-50 a barrel, with December paper early talked little changed at $22.25-50. Jan paper firmed slightly to the $22.75-23.00 area.
High sulphurs in NYH also were relatively flat on the day, with 2.2 percent still quoted on either side of $20.50.
At the U.S. Gulf, one percent was steady to up slightly at $19.50-75, while three percent remained under pressure, off a quarter to $17.25-50.
USG December three percent paper was talked in the $17.30-40 range, traders said.
No NYH or USG deals were reported.
New York city gate swing gas firmed 20 cents Wednesday to the $4.40/mmBtu area, well-above NYH one percent resid at a $3.55/mmBtu equivalent.
